CURRENT SEASON · GIRLS HIGH SCHOOL VOLLEYBALL

The $250
match package.

This package covers one team’s varsity volleyball match, girls or boys. Girls season is the current local focus.

Use the next-day photos for a match recap, then share the gallery with your team and families. Families can download the delivered photos without a separate purchase.

See JCA vs. Plainfield North
↗

Portfolio example; its larger photo count is not the package quantity.

One varsity match
I arrive 20 minutes before the confirmed varsity start. Coverage includes warm-ups, match action, celebrations and bench reactions, through the final point within a 3-hour on-site window. That window starts at the agreed arrival time and includes delays. Any extension needs a separate agreement; there are no automatic overtime charges.
10 edited preview photos within 24 hours
Selected, edited still photos ready for a recap or team post. They are part of the full gallery, not an additional set.
A curated gallery, edited within 5 days
Plan for around 40–60 edited photos, including the previews. This is a package estimate, not a guaranteed count. A short match may produce fewer; individual player counts are not guaranteed. Schools and established organizations receive the gallery within five calendar days, independently of the invoice due date. For individuals, the gallery is ready within five calendar days; the balance is due when it is ready, before full-resolution downloads.
Downloads and sharing
High-resolution JPEGs for school and team websites, social posts, newsletters, yearbooks and family personal use. Digital downloads are included; prints and raw files are not part of this package.
Local travel
Travel within a 45-minute drive of Aurora (60504) is included. I confirm the venue with your match date before accepting the booking.

BEFORE WE BOOK

Booking and
photo use.
How do payment and booking work?

The volleyball match package is $250. Both payment routes require written confirmation of availability and school access before the date is booked.

Schools and established organizations: no deposit. An approved purchase order or signed agreement reserves the date. We confirm an authorized payer and billing contact before shooting. The invoice is due 30 calendar days after the event, and the full gallery is delivered within 5 calendar days regardless of the invoice due date.

Individuals: a $125 deposit reserves the confirmed date. The remaining $125 is due when the gallery is ready, before full-resolution downloads. The gallery is ready within 5 calendar days; late payment delays downloads, not editing.

Both routes include ten edited preview photos within 24 hours. A form submission or payment preference does not confirm a booking or organizational billing approval.

Coverage begins September 19, 2026. If you have a date, include it; otherwise leave it blank. Email me about events after December 31. Every booking needs confirmation.
